integrity: A standard-library exact verifier independently enumerates the 36 double-sixes in two ways, checks the Gram polynomial, and confirms local Smith factors at each determinant prime for two deleted vertices. The complete code is embedded with the scientific text.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-zero cubic-surface configuration only; the result describes the graph critical group, not geometric Picard torsion or arithmetic twists. Priority remains provisional pending specialist review.
title: Integral critical group of the cubic-surface line–double-six incidence graph
